title: Bike or bus?
checked: Every reachable state checked (3 states, 81 with their data, 195 steps). All 4 rules hold.

rules.rule: Every step can happen, and none is a dead end
rules.says: Each of the 3 states is reached from the start, every step can fire, and no state leaves you stuck.

rules.rule: The bus is cheaper only below 48 rides
rules.says: While the bus is cheaper, the fares so far are under the £120 bike.
The bike has paid for itself exactly when 48 fares make £120.
rules.path: Take away the at the break-even guard and it breaks in 1 step: ride.

rules.rule: The bike wins only past 48 rides
rules.says: The bike is cheaper only once the fares would pass £120.
